groups.label: White blooms
groups.blurb: Creamy white main flowers scattered down the columns.

items.role: Large creamy Austin roses along the top-left — the main flower.
White phalaenopsis blooms tucked mid-lower, petals trailing lightly.
A few soft white ranunculus woven through the greenery.

groups.label: Yellow accents
groups.blurb: Fluffy yellow mimosa giving the arrangement its warm spark.

items.role: Clusters of fluffy yellow mimosa (silver wattle) — the key yellow accent of this look.
Fine yellow line flowers scattered sparsely.

groups.label: Greens & trailing strands
groups.blurb: Layered forest greens with long hanging strands — the core of this twin-column design.

items.role: Mid-size split monstera leaves adding tropical breadth.
Large matte heart-shaped leaves at the base, adding visual weight.
Fluffy light-green needle foliage forming the base layer.
Long vertical hanging tassels creating the flowing movement.
Fine misty green branches softening the mass.
Fine feathery fronds spread across the upper layer.
Grey-green round leaves bridging the green layers.
Warm brown reed lines on the right, balancing the cool greens.
